primary.title: On the Origin of Species
primary.author: Charles Darwin
primary.rationale: Darwin's seminal work, fundamental to evolutionary biology and natural selection. Widely available.

primary.title: The Descent of Man, and Selection in Relation to Sex
primary.author: Charles Darwin
primary.rationale: Explores human evolution and sexual selection, a significant follow-up to 'Origin of Species'.

primary.title: The Voyage of the Beagle
primary.author: Charles Darwin
primary.rationale: Darwin's account of his travels and observations during the second voyage of HMS Beagle, which laid the groundwork for his later theories.

secondary.title: Darwin's Dangerous Idea: Evolution and the Meanings of Life
secondary.author: Daniel C. Dennett
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive philosophical exploration of Darwin's ideas and their implications, by a prominent philosopher.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Darwin
secondary.author: David N. Reznick
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars covering various aspects of Darwin's life, work, and legacy.

secondary.title: Charles Darwin: A Very Short Introduction
secondary.author: Jonathan Hodge
secondary.rationale: A concise overview of Darwin's life and scientific contributions, suitable for an introduction to his work.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are widely available in digital archives. Secondary sources are influential academic works published after 1976.
